Root’s A acceptance explicitly retains the typed checkpoint allocation increase: **1,110,120→3,829,760 B for one checkpoint call (+2,719,640 B; 3.45×)** and **5,849→6,534 allocations (+685)**. Timing is **INCONCLUSIVE** on both sides. Baseline already includes a **3,935,272 B** sample, above the candidate maximum; that overlap does not dismiss the median increase or identify its cause. Whole-process sampling and cumulative end-of-cell counters cannot attribute the additional work. **Causal attribution remains UNRESOLVED**; root accepts the visible cost within this finite profile. BSON read-view setup similarly rises **1,264→3,512 B/call (+2,248 B)** while allocations fall **12→11**; its timing remains inconclusive. These are setup/maintenance observations, distinct from steady returned-row costs. See [the original A decision](../../../../docs/evidence/r1-row-store-5061/_artifacts/final-M-3325dfe/results/A/root-cost-acceptance-original.json).

The selected C sweep crosses bio widths **96/4096 bytes**, actual request sizes **1/32 rows**, absent/email+city indexes and bio/email+city changes: **4096 live rows, 100 serial mutation requests and five fresh-DB repetitions in each of 16 groups (80 cells)**. All 80 original Flush/reopen full-row, current-posting and historical-posting oracles pass. Every cell records **100 UpdateBatch calls, 100 WAL appends, 100 logical syncs and 100 actual file-sync calls**; item counts are 100 or 3200. ACK includes publication. The separate Flush records zero deltas in all 13 selected counters; zero indexed_flush counters do not mean zero index work. Root accepts this selected criterion 6 cost characterization in [the original C decision](../../../../docs/evidence/r1-row-store-5061/_artifacts/final-M-3325dfe/results/C/root-cost-acceptance-original.json); [the C descriptive report](../../../../docs/evidence/r1-row-store-5061/_artifacts/final-M-3325dfe/results/C/descriptive-report.md) and [full summary](../../../../docs/evidence/r1-row-store-5061/_artifacts/final-M-3325dfe/results/C/summary.json) retain every group.

The sweep uses **generic full JSON row replacement** through public UpdateBatch. Observed whole-process Go allocation is **0.835–7.685 MB/request** (decimal MB): roughly **0.835–1.031 MB** for one row and **4.774–7.685 MB** for 32 rows. Batching shares request/publication/sync work, but wider requests still replace whole rows and carry full-row WAL costs even when only email and city change. The samples include default background activity and harness bookkeeping; current-read and narrow prepare timers cover only their named slices, and publication/sync scopes overlap. They provide a cost map without per-stage allocation attribution or proof that these temporary allocations are necessary. No native partial setter or eligible metadata-only performance path was measured. Separately source-qualified metadata reference/no-vector-rewrite correctness remains distinct.

**Twelve ACK groups are within 15% spread; all four wide 32-row ACK groups remain INCONCLUSIVE (16.1–16.8% spread). Fifteen of sixteen separate Flush groups are also INCONCLUSIVE.** No outlier removal, repeat, noisy timing ratio or comparison to stale mutation packets is promoted. This finite serial characterization does not establish general scale, peak/RSS or duration-unbounded whole-DB capacity. Larger-population and concurrency work remains the accepted #5057 deferral; broader transaction guarantees remain separate in #1186.

For actual main `3325dfe77940fec8587d8b61b1ac4e0b2f72caca`, the frozen six-engine A profile uses 4096 live rows, 32-row batches, 1000 calls and five fresh-DB repetitions under the retained durable/flushed contract. It covers retained-document JSON, template-v1, BSON, typed rows and SQLite JSON/row adapters. The matched comparison has **20 stable groups**, all with M/baseline throughput ratio at least **0.95994**, **72 inconclusive groups**, and **one newly enabled group**. The unchanged 15% spread and throughput-loss guards retain every sample. Root accepts this finite profile in [the original A cost decision](../../../../docs/evidence/r1-row-store-5061/_artifacts/final-M-3325dfe/results/A/root-cost-acceptance-original.json).
